characteristics.$text:
This model must be your warlord and while withing 3" of a friendly **Iron Hands Infantry** model this model gains **Lone Operative**.


All **Iron Hand** units gain **The flesh is weak but deeds endure** ability

characteristics.$text: This unit has a **[Feel No Pain 6+]** or if it natural has one [Not including ones that only happen for **ranged attacks**, **Psychic attacks** or **temporary** ones] improve it by 1 instead.

modifiers.arg: This unit has a **[Feel No Pain 6+]** or if it natural has one [Not including ones that only happen for **ranged attacks**, **Psychic attacks** or **temporary** ones] improve it by 1 instead.
modifiers.value: At the end of your **turn** roll a D6 for each model in this unit that has this ability that is missing a wound. On each 5+ restore 1 wound. If it already has a ability that happens at the end of the turn that restores a wound by dice roll improve the rolls for that by 1 instead.
